_comment: Exceptions for tool/verify_doc_refs.dart. Every entry needs a reason. 'files': docs whose backticked paths are not checked (plans and audits that name files that do not exist yet, or that describe another repository); relative Markdown links in them are still checked. 'targets': backticked paths that are allowed in any checked doc.
